title: 'Cracked Adit' (a boarded, condemned mine north of Cinderhall's head-frame) resolves the 'work the already-loosened corner' check with a one-line success and a few gold, then offers no further exit ('go in') or any other action — reads as a stub/dead end rather than a deliberate small reward.
